title: 第30章 恐怖的唱反调
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
同样，姜怀玉和玉凝也怕陆沉把她们给赶出去。

    但她们的担心显然是多余了，此刻的陆沉，已经彻底醉了。

    上有姜怀玉在他太阳穴上轻轻按着，下有玉凝跪在榻前为他洗漱，他眼皮都懒得抬起来。

    “陆郎，”玉凝的声音软软的。

    “你听见我们说的话了吗？”

    “嗯？”

    “家里就这么大，以后人多了，住不下怎么办？”玉凝杏眼水润润地看着他。

    “师姐说，你在外面还有别的姐妹……”

    姜怀玉的手指顿了顿，没有说话，只是把脸埋进他的肩窝里，呼吸温温热热地拂在他的颈侧。

    陆沉被她蹭得发痒，迷迷糊糊地笑了一声。

    他抬起手，拍了拍姜怀玉环在他腰上的手臂：“住不下？谁跟你们说住不下的？”

    两女对视了一眼，以为他在说醉话。

    “陆郎，你醉了。”

    “我没醉。”

    陆沉忽然坐直了身子，把两女都吓了一跳。

    他那双眼睛里亮得吓人，像是忽然想起了什么了不得的事。

    “你们说住不下？”他抬起右手，在手背上拍了拍。

    “这里面可大得很！”

    姜怀玉和玉凝面面相觑。

    陆沉把手背翻过来，凑到两人面前。

    那道魅姬给的魔纹在手背上，像一朵含苞待放的花，泛着幽幽的光泽。

    “看！魅姬给我开的魔纹空间，经过我开发，能装下一座小山！别说你们几个，把整个玄天宗的女人都叫来，也能装得下！”

    “你还想要玄天宗所有的女人！”玉凝娇嗔，只当他胡说。

    “魅姬？”

    姜怀玉的声音忽然冷了几分。

    “她是哪个？？”

    “就是……魔门的一个魔女，长得可好看了！”

    他比划了一下，手指还没比划完，就被姜怀玉一把按住了。
content_en:
Similarly, Jiang Huaiyu and Yu Ning were also afraid that Lu Chen would kick them out.

But their worries were obviously unnecessary. At this moment, Lu Chen was completely drunk.

Jiang Huaiyu was pressing gently on his temples, and Yu Ning was kneeling in front of the couch to wash him. He didn't even bother to raise his eyelids.

"Lu Lang," Yu Ning's voice was soft.

"Did you hear what we said?"

"Huh?"

"The house is so big. What if we can't fit in more people in the future?" Yu Ning looked at him with watery almond-shaped eyes.

"Senior sister said that you have other sisters outside..."

Jiang Huaiyu paused with his fingers and didn't speak. He just buried his face in his shoulder and breathed warmly on the side of his neck.

Lu Chen was tickled by her rubbing and laughed drowsily.

He raised his hand and patted Jiang Huaiyu's arm around his waist: "Can't live here? Who told you that we can't live here?"

The two women looked at each other, thinking he was talking drunkenly.

"Lu Lang, you are drunk."

"I'm not drunk."

Lu Chen suddenly sat up straight, startling both women.

His eyes were frighteningly bright, as if he suddenly remembered something extraordinary.

"You said you can't stop?" He raised his right hand and patted the back of it.

"It's really big in here!"

Jiang Huaiyu and Yu Ning looked at each other.

Lu Chen turned the back of his hand over and came closer to the two of them.

The magic pattern given by Mei Ji is on the back of the hand, like a budding flower, glowing with a faint luster.

"Look! The magic pattern space that Mei Ji opened for me, after I developed it, can hold a small mountain! Not to mention you guys, even if you call all the women of Xuantian Sect, it can hold it!"

"You still want all the women in the Xuantian Sect!" Yu Ning said coquettishly, thinking he was just talking nonsense.

"Mei Ji?"

Jiang Huaiyu's voice suddenly became colder.

"Which one is she??"

"She's just...a witch from the Demon Sect. She's so pretty!"

He made a gesture, but before he could finish the gesture, Jiang Huaiyu held him down.
